fixes.what: Add `--gutter:36px` for the canopy page on phones (keep --tree-w:120vw). The copy currently runs to within ~4px of the ~22px bark slivers (phone shots 1–3: 'Multi-day celebrations, run to the minute.' touches the trunk).

At 390px the falling fruit sits at x≈-7..18px over the bark and shows as a cut-off magenta half-disc at the left edge (phone shot 1, y≈620): it reads as a rendering glitch, not motion.
